findings.message: The field "Nome" asks for the user's full name but does not identify that purpose: autocomplete="name" is missing. Chromium's own form check flags this field too.

patch.after: <input type="text" class="" id="name" placeholder="ex.: João da Silva Gomes" required="" minlength="5" aria-label="Nome" name="name" pattern="[a-zA-ZÀ-ú]+( [a-zA-ZÀ-ú]+)*" data-msg-valuemissing="Informe seu nome completo" data-msg-patternmismatch="Informe seu nome completo" autocomplete="name">

findings.message: The field "E-mail" asks for the user's email address but does not identify that purpose: autocomplete="email" is missing. Chromium's own form check flags this field too.
